products.name: Pancake
products.description: Pancake is the Vercel for GTM. It gives you the building blocks to deploy any go-to-market idea from your favorite AI agent, such as Claude or Codex: a GTM Brain, sending infrastructure, and 40+ data providers and enrichment, all accessible through one MCP connection.

products.name: Inferock
products.tagline: Serverless inference, with credits back for failed calls.
products.description: Get free signup credits to use all available models on Inferock. Bring your own keys: run your OpenAI, Claude or Gemini accounts, see where calls fail and what they cost, and get credits back on eligible failed calls. Serverless: pay-per-token LLM inference. Get signup credits to start using.

products.name: Retriever AI
products.tagline: Free AI browser agent: find leads, reach out, apply to jobs
products.description: Retriever is a free AI browser agent that finishes work across websites. Ask it to find leads and send outreach, shortlist TikTok and Instagram creators for your next campaign, or apply to jobs. Run tasks in your own Chrome browser or in cloud browsers hosted by rtrvr. It beats OpenAI, Anthropic, and Muse on accuracy, runs 5x faster, and costs 300x less.

products.name: Tiden
products.description: Tiden verifies your coding agents built what you actually asked for. Most checks run inside the session that wrote the code, so the tests agree with it by construction. Tiden keeps your intent as requirements that branch and merge like code, and checks every change against that record. The verdict comes from tests run in your environment; no model grades the diff. You decide what merges, and production errors trace back to the release. Works beside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot.

products.name: daily.dev for agents
products.description: daily.dev is where millions of developers find out what's next. Now your agent can too. Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client to read personalized feeds, search posts, learn from discussions, save bookmarks and tune your feed. In addition, plugin marketplace and apps ecosystem. YOUR AGENTS CAN READ daily.dev NOW!!

products.name: AdAnt 2.0
products.description: AdAnt AI is your proactive, 24/7 social media marketing team. The Strategist researches your niche on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Meta Ads and writes content strategies that work. The Creator turns every strategy into a batch of videos. The Analyst listens on X and Reddit for conversations worth joining. The Manager plans the calendar and posts. Built on the strategies our founding team used to generate 100M+ organic views and cut paid acquisition costs by 60% on average.

products.name: Confidence by Spotify
products.tagline: Build products at full speed, with both hands on the wheel
products.description: Confidence is a product intelligence platform built by Spotify. Spotify's approach to building products has always combined data with judgment and taste, and that scientific rigor is what Confidence brings to customers. Confidence is born from experimentation, but that’s now part of a wider story. Confidence analyzes your user signals, surfaces what's working, suggests the next move, and validates the hypothesis before it ships. You stay in the loop and approve the moves that matter.

products.name: Reason
products.tagline: A state-of-the-art coding agent for cost efficiency
products.description: Reason is the best coding agent, in the cloud or locally. Give it a task and it writes code, runs tests and opens a pull request. Use Reason from the Mac app, terminal, web or Slack, with your choice of models and connected subscriptions. Start free on your own computer. Our published GPT-6 Astra evaluation scores 65.1 on the Coding Agent Index vs Codex’s 62.5, at 22% lower cost per solved task.

products.name: Exodus for Google Cloud Run
products.tagline: Upgrade any app to Cloud Run, with your coding agent
products.description: Cloud Run is Google's managed platform: no servers to look after, new copies in seconds under load, a bill only while your code works. Exodus takes your app there with your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor): it checks the app on your machine, shows what you pay today and on Cloud Run and what to change, by 50+ playbooks from real moves. Then the agent makes the move, task by task, or designs a new app for Cloud Run. Free and open source. Try it on your repo today.

products.name: AirJelly
products.description: AirJelly is an always-on desktop AI agent that proactively captures your intent, organizes your tasks, and gets things done. By observing your on-screen activities, it knows who you are and what you're working on. It doesn't just spot your to-dos — it foresees what's next and acts. It also tracks your personal interactions, so you'll never miss a follow-up or forget a promise. Everything in your life is managed by AirJelly — freeing your time for what AI can't do, or simply for you to enjoy.

products.name: Specreel
products.description: Paste your app's URL and Specreel walks it in a real browser, turning your key flows into narrated, shareable demos. Already on Playwright? It renders them from your test traces on every green build, so a demo can't go stale. Open-source CLI + hosted Cloud.

products.name: Microsoft Maia 300
products.tagline: Microsoft’s own AI chip, headed to multi-gigawatts
products.description: Maia 300 is Microsoft’s next-generation AI inference platform, announced Oct 12, 2026. Per Microsoft, it’s built for long-context reasoning, low-latency conversation, and agents, with 8 HBM4 stacks, TSMC N2P compute chiplets, and 96-accelerator racks. Microsoft claims 40% more tokens per megawatt. Production starts in 2027, and Azure Maia scales to multi-gigawatt deployments, becoming the main inference system for Microsoft’s products.

products.name: Rambox
products.tagline: Ready-to-use workspaces as you switch tasks and contexts
products.description: A major Rambox redesign focused on making everyday work simpler, faster and easier to navigate. The new interface reduces friction and the number of clicks needed to move between apps, workspaces, tasks and contexts, while a redesigned onboarding experience makes Rambox easier to set up and understand. This release also adds faster access to what you need, improved tabs and context persistence, Unified Search, Quick View, Command Center and new focus tools.

products.name: Nimble
products.description: Today, we are announcing Nimble-v4 and Nimble-v4-max which are pushing the frontier of decision models, outperforming Jev and other variants. On Decision Index public scores, our nimble-v4-max model and nimble-v4 models score +10.5 and +5.74 against Jev 1.13, making nimble-v4-max a top performing model. Beyond benchmarks, we have done a lot of internal evals, and see big improvements: 43% fewer mistakes than Jev, +50pp on model routing decisions, and so on. Try for free: console.bespokelabs.ai

products.name: Mira Tours
products.description: Mira is your AI tour guide. Walking audio tours, anywhere in the world: chat to build your own, or just start walking and hear the story of the places around you.
